settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, language, account and your data.
settings.language.desc: Usually your browser's. It applies to your account, on every device.
settings.mode.desc: On this device, saved in a cookie.
settings.color.desc: The color of buttons, links and charts.
settings.app.title: App on your phone
settings.app.desc: Nutreek opens full screen like an app, without the browser bar, and loads faster.
settings.app.generic: From the browser menu choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”. No store needed.
settings.app.prompt_text: It installs from the browser, no store needed.
settings.app.ios_text: On iPhone and iPad you add it from Safari.
settings.app.installed_text: You are using Nutreek as an app. To remove it, press and hold the icon on the Home screen.
settings.app.https_text: Installing and the camera only work when Nutreek is opened over https. Whoever runs this instance can turn it on from the proxy (for example Traefik or Caddy).
settings.account.title: Account
settings.password.err_short: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.data.title: Your data
settings.data.export_hint: Weight, workouts, recipes, plans: everything in one file.
settings.tokens.title: API tokens
settings.tokens.for_apps: for external apps, e.g. Home Assistant
settings.tokens.created: Token created: copy it now, it will not be shown again.
settings.tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke the token “{{.Name}}”? Apps that use it will stop working.
settings.tokens.once: The value is shown only once, right after it is created.
settings.tokens.premium_note: Creating tokens is part of Premium.
settings.delete.title: Delete account
settings.delete.desc: Permanently deletes plans, recipes, weigh-ins and everything else (GDPR art. 17).
settings.delete.confirm: Delete the account and all its data? This cannot be undone.
